jobs.title: Lead Frontend Engineer (React)
jobs.content: <p>Acme Ledger is hiring a Lead Frontend Engineer.</p><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>7+ years of software engineering experience, 4+ years of React</li><li>Experience leading a team or acting as tech lead</li><li>TypeScript, GraphQL, CI/CD, Playwright or Cypress</li></ul><h3>Nice to have</h3><ul><li>Next.js, AWS</li></ul>
